title: ALMA Observations of HCN and Its Isotopologues on Titan
question: What are the abundances and isotopic ratios (12C/13C, 14N/15N, D/H) of HCN isotopologues in Titan's atmosphere, and can new isotopologues be detected, using archival ALMA calibration data?

what.value: Disk-averaged atmospheric temperature profile from CO (2-1) retrieval

evidence.quote: We assume the disk-averaged atmospheric temperature profile derived by (cite: serigano16) using an April 2014 observation of the CO (2-1) line

what.value: Reference atmosphere and collision-induced absorption parameters

evidence.quote: The reference atmosphere and collision-induced absorption parameters used in this paper are the same as in (cite: teanby13)

what.value: Line wavenumbers and intensities from CDMS-recommended laboratory data

evidence.quote: Spectral line wavenumbers and intensities were taken from (cite: ahrens02), (cite: brunken04), and (cite: fuchs04)

what.value: Lorentz half-width 0.13 at 296 K and temperature exponent 0.75

evidence.quote: The Lorentzian broadening half-width at 296 K ($\gamma$) was assumed to be 0.13 (cite: yang08)

recipe.method: Integrate each channel within a circular region covering pixels above 3 sigma; Doppler correct to Titan rest frame; convert to radiance using Horizons distance and velocity
assumptions: Seasonal changes negligible over the period

recipe.method: NEMESIS iterative chi-square minimization on the HCN (1-0) line with limb-brightening weighted sum, fixed temperature profile
key_parameters: A priori error 200%, smoothing three scale heights; 72 averaging points
assumptions: Isothermal 160 K above 500 km; relax to Huygens below 80 km; HCN saturation below ~80 km

recipe.method: Retrieve scaling factor of the HCN profile shape for each isotopologue line; ratio equals the scale factor
key_parameters: Line strength uncertainty 2%; gamma and tau errors <10%
assumptions: Constant isotopic ratio with altitude; same gamma and tau for all isotopologues

evidence.quote: The continuum emission from Titan modeled by NEMESIS is $\sim$3% less than the continuum level of the data

not_stated_but_needed: Exact ALMA execution blocks/scheduling blocks per line
Line-free window used for continuum rescaling
Mask and clean threshold/iterations, cell and image size
missing_for_reproduction: NEMESIS configuration and a priori profile
score_reason: Public data and a clear recipe, but NEMESIS setup details and several choices are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe is mostly described and the results are numeric.
